edits.new:
spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      volumes:
edits.why: Disable SA token automount and apply RuntimeDefault seccomp; the workload doesn't need API access per the manifest.
Block privilege escalation; safe for nginx.

skipped.reason: hostPath /var/lib/agent is used for state; replacing it needs a decision on persistent storage (PVC/emptyDir), which could lose data.
CPU/memory limits need real usage numbers.
Read-only root needs knowledge of the paths the app writes (nginx writes cache/run dirs).
The nginx image runs as root by default; runAsNonRoot or a UID needs an unprivileged image or testing.
Needs a separate NetworkPolicy resource and knowledge of required traffic.
